Install cursor-cli on Omarchy

Cursor CLI brings Cursor's AI coding agents to the terminal, so they can be run interactively, wired into GitHub Actions, or scripted into other automations without opening the full IDE. It supports the same range of underlying models as Cursor's desktop app, includes a shell mode for running commands with safety checks, and is meant for tasks like auto-updating docs, triggering security reviews, or building custom agents into CI pipelines.

Watch: The Cursor CLI is Actually Good!? ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add cursor-cli
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1:2026.10.16.1.e3cb207-1:
    pacman -Qi cursor-cli

Open and use cursor-cli

cursor-cli has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql cursor-cli | grep /usr/bin/

cursor-cli requirements and compatibility

  • A Cursor account
  • Network access to reach Cursor's model backend
  • A paid Cursor plan for extended agent usage

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • git

Frequently asked questions

How do I install cursor-cli on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add cursor-cli. The download is 172.9 MB and it takes 585.9 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is cursor-cli free?

Shares Cursor's account and plan tiers (free Hobby tier, paid Pro/Pro+/Ultra/Teams plans). The package is licensed LicenseRef-Cursor.

How do I uninstall cursor-cli?

Run omarchy pkg drop cursor-cli. It removes the package from your system.

What does cursor-cli depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: gcc-libs, git, zlib. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is cursor-cli a desktop app?

No. cursor-cli has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is cursor-cli in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as cursor-cli (version 1:2026.10.16.1.e3cb207-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Anysphere makes it. Project site: https://cursor.com/cli.
